name: Top Coder
tagline: Codes to locked criteria, then proves every one with a test
description: Codes against a fixed list of acceptance criteria, and for each one it supplies a test that demonstrates the behaviour instead of an assertion that claims it. Before anything is called finished, a separate checker goes back over the result independently. Done, here, means verified rather than merely written.
author: EricBuess
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
